description: This file defines a singleton enum CritterIconRenderer in Swift that generates a critter icon as an NSImage, composed of various components such as body, face, eyes, ears, legs, and optional badges. It encapsulates logic for rendering a cartoonish critter with customizable features like blinking, ear wiggle, and badges, intended for use in macOS applications.

methods.name: makeIcon
methods.description: Creates an NSImage of the critter icon with specified features, optionally including a badge. Sets up the drawing context and invokes internal methods to render body and face.

methods.name: makeBitmapRep
methods.description: Creates a bitmap image representation with a fixed pixel size to ensure crispness on Retina displays.

methods.name: makeCanvas
methods.description: Initializes a Canvas struct that facilitates drawing with proper scaling, including snapping functions for pixel alignment.

methods.name: drawBody
methods.description: Draws the body, ears, and legs of the critter on the canvas.

methods.name: drawFace
methods.description: Draws the face, including eyes, eye holes, and blinking effects, with configurations for ear holes and closed eyes.

methods.name: drawBadge
methods.description: Draws a badge in the upper right corner with varying prominence levels and symbols.
